claimText: If the aircraft fails to indicate that it is able to receive and acknowledge transmissions, separation shall be maintained between the aircraft having the communication failure and other aircraft, based on the assumption that the aircraft will, if in visual meteorological conditions: continue to fly in visual meteorological conditions; land at the nearest suitable aerodrome; and report its arrival by the most expeditious means to the appropriate air traffic control unit.
rationale: Enumerated list item 'a' defines the specific assumption for separation maintenance in VMC conditions.
